purpose: Test whether early/late voltage observations reduce source-order/strength ambiguity on new evaluation strengths, without changing the tissue, cues, reader, feature count or margin.
remaining_implementation: Adapt the established windowed assay runner and prerequisite/history checks to the new cohort and the fixed spanning feature extractor; run host preflight before registering and launching.
hypothesis: With the same 15 features and calibration strengths, the spanning panel resolves more joint location/order cases than the late-only comparator while retaining the location signal. Report any failures and paired changes; improvement does not establish complete task resolution.
evaluation_design: Four equally spaced new strengths in each calibration interval, mirrored around 0.6, including weak cues near 0.4. Fix this grid before generating its responses; do not restrict testing to the previously successful strength range.

physical_conditions.inherited_conditions: Same compensated-charge production sources, initial state, tissue, location allocations, single-task and null controls, per-source doses at each strength and all physical/numerical tolerances. No new native BETSE capture is needed when these production sources remain authenticated and unchanged.

reader.sampling: Retain the source run's 12 observation times, so both panels come from the same trajectory and require no extra integration. Concatenate five remote voltages per selected time with no rescaling.
reader.calibration: Fit each arm and timestep using calibration cases only. Prediction receives voltage features only; no evaluation strength, labels or paired counterpart.
reader.analysis: Keep the existing timestep score/contrast limits, all 32 fixed label shuffles and reference-assisted transfer as separately labelled analyses. The old 8/16 primary and exploratory 15/16 result remain frozen.

scientific_reporting.primary: Report correct and above-margin counts for each task and both tasks together, every case's score, and the paired change versus late-only observations.
scientific_reporting.full_target: All 32 joint cases correct and above the unchanged margin, with timestep stability and appropriate controls. A numerical pass or partial improvement is not completion of this scientific target.
scientific_reporting.scope: New deterministic strength interpolation tests in the same synthetic tissue; not independent biological replication or whole-organism validation.

execution.launch: Detached with durable inputs, logs, result/failure artifacts and no automatic follow-up. Outputs under /mnt/workspaces/Cells. Estimates require resource preflight.
verification: Authenticate completed precision-repair and diagnostic evidence, unchanged production sources and disjoint new evaluation strengths.
Independently verify all control samples, doses, observation support and resource bounds before response simulation.
Require the unchanged calibration and no-cue physical histories to reproduce their authenticated predecessors; map new IDs explicitly.
Keep complete windowed state archives, conservation/domain checks and the full CPU/L4 comparison with unchanged tolerances.
Require bitwise restart across the second pulse, window changes, world reordering and partitioning within each backend.
execution.telemetry: Record both GPU-busy and measured SM-active with coverage and phase scope, plus actual arm timings. Equal world-step budgets do not establish concurrent multi-GPU scaling.
